faq.q: Why do printing presses need CorelDRAW X7?
faq.a: Many commercial printing presses and RIP plotters run CorelDRAW X7 or X8 for compatibility with industrial machinery. Newer files from CorelDRAW 2021-2024 cannot be opened without downgrading.

faq.q: Are my design files uploaded to any server?
faq.a: No! {brand} runs 100% in your browser using local processing. Your private graphic designs and vectors never leave your device.

faq.q: What versions can I downgrade to?
faq.a: You can convert between CorelDRAW versions including X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2024.
